work.name: PT Indocyber Global Teknologi (IGLO) at BRI
work.summary: Developing backend microservices for Bank BRI's Universal Biller System (UBS), a centralized biller management platform integrated with BRImo and the Payment Engine middleware. Focused on service development, database design, workflow orchestration, and asynchronous inter-service communication.
highlights: Developed Partner Service to manage partner-related data and integrations within the Universal Biller System.
Developed Product Service to manage biller product data and support product-related operations.
Designed the database schema for the workflow submission process, applying loose coupling principles to separate submission management from core business services.
Implemented Kafka consumers to support asynchronous communication and integration between backend services and external systems.
Contributed to a microservices architecture using Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, and GORM.

work.name: PT Guardia Teknologi Indonesia (Jubelio)
work.summary: Developed backend services for Jubelio Store and Jubelio Chat, focusing on API performance, marketplace integrations, asynchronous processing, and real-time communication.
highlights: Optimized Jubelio Store Order Service to achieve response times of under 2 seconds.
Integrated Jubelio Chat with Sentiment AI and multiple marketplace messaging platforms, including Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop.
Developed product and order synchronization features and integrated Supabase for real-time messaging.
Implemented marketplace-specific pagination, time-based message retrieval, and retry-with-delay handling for HTTP 429 responses to improve synchronization reliability.
Validated synchronization across 3 tenants with multiple marketplace stores per tenant, completing tests in under 15 minutes.
Developed Cart Service with Redis caching to improve performance and implemented asynchronous order consumers and notification systems via WhatsApp and email.
Automated bulk shipping label generation by converting HTML templates to PDF using wkhtmltopdf.

projects.name: Si Subur
projects.description: Si Subur is an IoT-based fertility monitoring system that uses basal body temperature (BBT) to track menstrual cycles and estimate fertility periods. The system combines an ESP8266 microcontroller and an infrared temperature sensor with a web application for real-time temperature monitoring. Developed as a college project, Si Subur aims to make fertility tracking more accessible through technology.
highlights: Monitoring
